snippet.title: Nortubel Second Trailer With Song
snippet.description:
Second trailer, with a specific ratio because it's done for another /v/3 event.
This time, I installed LMMS and felt like doing a song of my own.
NOTE: Would like any helpful tip and resources for the program because I am still now.

I wanted to show new stuff here, specially some stuff that I didn't really get to show on the previous trailer.
I also wanted to release this trailer alongside the chapter 8/Untotern update.
But if the update is not out right now, it could at least a few hours later.
